14. The learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners also submits that the decisions of the learned Judge, অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ অতিরিক্ত ট্রাইব্যুনাল-১, সিরাজগঞ্জ below, being based on facts and circumstances and evidence on record and there being findings over the points in issues and there being found no error of law or fact in passing the judgment and the impugned judgment and decree dated 20.05.2014 is not a proper judgment of reversal and as such fell into an error of law occasioning a failure of justice calling for interference by this Hon'ble Court and as such impugned judgment and decree dated 20.05.2014 passed by the learned Appellate Tribunal, অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আপীল ট্রাইব্যুনাল below without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

 22. We further find that the learned Judge, অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ অতিরিক্ত ট্রাইব্যুনাল-১, সিরাজগঞ্জ below, being based on facts and circumstances and evidence on record and there being findings over the points in issues and there being found no error of law or fact in passing the judgment by the Tribunal as such the impugned judgment and decree dated 20.05.2014 is not a proper judgment of reversal and as such fell into an error of law occasioning failure of justice calling for interference by this Hon'ble Court and as such impugned judgment and decree dated 20.05.2014 passed by the learned Appellate Tribunal অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আপীল ট্রাইব্যুনাল below without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
